composition_variation: Create an original high-quality 2D anime illustration of one beautiful 29-year-old adult woman with youthful adult vitality and a mature, self-assured presence. Design warm golden-brown eyes, refined mature cheekbones, a graceful nose, and a contented smile. Her dark-chocolate waves are pinned back on one side so the face stays clear. She wears an opaque ivory short-sleeved linen blouse, rust-orange wide-leg cropped trousers, and simple woven flats. Seated upright at a small lakeside picnic table, she pours tea from a compact thermos into a plain cup, keeping both hands close together over the tabletop and the stream short and believable. A folded cloth and a small fruit bowl add restrained everyday detail. Calm water, distant reeds, and a soft tree canopy provide the backdrop. Use chocolate brown, rust orange, warm ivory, and muted blue-green, with mellow late-afternoon light. Use an eye-level camera and a calm three-quarter-length portrait. Place her centrally in the middle and lower frame, entirely inside a narrow phone-safe composition; keep hands close to her torso. Reserve the upper 25% as uncluttered light atmosphere for the lock-screen clock. Natural anatomy, opaque clothing, no text, no logos, no additional people.
